name: cityguess
description: CityGuess — a competitive multiplayer city-guessing game for 2–8 friends.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
